name: Quintus Caelius (Librarius)
notes: Unit scribe and records keeper. Codex on belt, cipher seal. Produces official-looking documentation.
gm_notes: NPC Librarius. Corvinus's documentation control. Produces records that protect Corvinus's claim to discovery at the vault. The party Librarius role (if taken) has a rival here: Quintus files reports that do not always match what actually happened. DC 13 Investigation: one of his filed reports has an inconsistency in the dates. DC 15: the inconsistency was deliberate -- the dating on a document was adjusted to predate the actual dig.
